data.device_name: Device name (prefix of the entity names)
data.jk_display_index_start: JK BMS pack numbering start (JK only)

init.title: Integration options
init.description: Poll interval and debug logging apply to every device type. Inverter control (JSD SOLAR only) turns the settings into editable entities and adds control buttons; every change is checked, must be confirmed by the inverter and is read back. The Power Off, Reset Energy Counters and Factory Reset buttons start disabled in the entity settings.

data.jsd_auto_clock_sync: Sync inverter date and time with Home Assistant when they differ (needs inverter control)
data.jk_balancer_enable_control: Enable balancer control (cell count, trigger, current, on/off)

data_description.debug_logging: Writes to the Home Assistant log (Settings → System → Logs). Turn it off when done: deep levels write a lot.
data_description.log_depth: Basic: cycle summary, identity, writes. Protocol: + every frame sent and received, with response time. Parsing: + parsed values of every command.
data_description.jk_balancer_address: Slave address set on the balancer, 1 by default.
data_description.pace_current_scale: Most PACE BMS report current in 0.01 A. If the current and power look 10 times too small, choose 0.1 A.

options.jsd_solar: JSD SOLAR inverter, RS232 2400 baud (J5500HPC/J5500HP, possibly others)
options.jk_balancer: JK active balancer, RS485 9600 baud (JK-B2A24S-RS485, possibly others)

send_command.name: Send inverter command
send_command.description: Sends one raw JSD SOLAR command and returns the reply. Queries (GBAT, CPR??, TE? …) always work; any other command is a write and needs inverter control enabled. Calibration commands are refused.

device_id.name: Inverter
device_id.description: Needed only when more than one JSD SOLAR inverter is set up.

command.name: Command
command.description: Command without the trailing CR, e.g. GBAT, CPR??, CPR03.

attempts.name: Attempts
attempts.description: Resend up to this many times while the inverter answers NAK or nothing.

refresh.name: Refresh inverter entities
refresh.description: Re-reads now only the commands behind the chosen entities and updates them, without waiting for the poll cycle. Returns the fresh values.
